title: Xavier and Sadie Herbert's Cottage
axis: Positive Z faces Kamerunga Road and Redlynch Railway Station. Negative X is toward the eastern side carport.
source: OpenStreetMap and Queensland Heritage Register GIS
identityStatus: The heritage parcel fixes the address opposite the station and alongside the hotel. The aligned northwest section of the long mapped roof covers the cottage. The mapped ring may merge the residence with later rear connections. Exact building separations are interpreted from the inventory.

features.role: Road-aligned mapped roof encompassing the heritage residence frontage and rear surfaces
